title: Kissed Spicy Polish Sausage Skillet
description: A resinous and velvety Polish dish with a Cajun twist, featuring broiled sausage and FODMAP-friendly ingredients. This adventurous recipe is perfect for those looking to spice up their meal routine.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook for an additional 3 minutes.
Add the diced tomato and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a small bowl, mix together the Cajun seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
Add the Polish sausage to the skillet and sprinkle with the Cajun seasoning mixture.
Transfer the skillet to the broiler and cook for 10 minutes, or until the sausage is browned and cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the broiler and stir in the garlic-infused oil.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
